engagement_background.objective: Reduce Cascade Residential Services’ procurement costs by roughly $0.87-$1.7 million through a 5-6 month strategic sourcing program that leverages enterprise-wide purchasing power, secures competitive supplier agreements, and establishes a best-in-class procurement process to support private-equity value creation.
engagement_background.scope_summary: Nine indirect/direct-indirect categories totaling about $33 million in baseline spend are in scope (≈$26.5 million addressable). Key areas include HVACR OEM/Distributors, HVAC & Plumbing Supplies, Advertising, General Industrial/Electrical Supplies, Electronic Payment Processing, Telecom, Fleet, Uniforms, and Commercial Print; low-opportunity categories may be dropped as analysis progresses.
constraints_challenges: Decentralized, multi-brand purchasing limits leverage and requires aggregation of spend across business units.
Supplier data requests may receive limited or delayed responses, hampering baseline build-out.
Minimal internal procurement bandwidth—Treya must do the "heavy lifting" while still needing timely stakeholder input.
Aggressive timeline (project start April 2025, completion by late September 2025) driven by PE value-creation targets.
Incumbent supplier sensitivities and potential stakeholder pushback when competitive bidding threatens long-standing relationships.

procurement_environment.data_availability: AP transaction data for Jan-Dec 2024 is available; detailed line-item usage and many contracts must be obtained directly from high-spend suppliers.
procurement_environment.data_quality_notes: Spend data lacks consistent vendor naming, tail spend may be non-addressable, and gaps exist when suppliers do not provide historical usage—necessitating representative sampling.
